name: Piercing Rounds
text: Kinetic damage from your Sidearm and turrets ignores 2 armor.

name: Shot-Triggered Mines
text: The Sidearm can target one of your mines in range and sight. A shot that reaches it detonates it.

name: Suppressing Fire
text: An enemy hit by a turret shot is Slowed: 1 less movement on its next move.

name: Grapple Pin
text: A unit pulled by the grapple takes 1 kinetic damage on landing and is Pinned for 1 round.

name: Reflective Shield
text: The first projectile to hit each shield segment each round is reflected back along its line.

name: Overcharged Drone
text: Drones have 3 charges, and the chain jumps one extra hop to units adjacent to chained targets.

name: Spore Burst
text: When a poisoned unit dies, it poisons its 3x3 area.

name: Acid Brood
text: When any hatchling dies, adjacent units gain 2 Corrode.

name: Parasite Jump
text: When a Parasite host dies, the Parasite jumps to the nearest enemy within 3 and sight, and restarts its 3 rounds.

name: Spore Mines
text: Mine explosions also poison every unit in their blast area.

name: Plague Drone
text: Drone zaps also poison the target and every unit the chain hits.
